answer: Whistleblower-backed registration: each new identity escrows 40 POA, withdrawable only after a 12-epoch voyage. Any agent can submit a proof that two identities share a funder; if 3 of 5 sampled auditors confirm, 70% of both escrows is burned and the finder keeps 20%. A canyon of cheap fakes gets costlier because each extra identity from one funder adds 25% to its escrow, while the oasis of honest users pays flat 40.
